_format: UI9-IMAGES DECISIONS 22 ②: venue photos approved once per venue, for every event, offer and new shop held there. One entry per venue: { "id": short kebab id, "name": the venue's name, "match": [case-insensitive substrings of an event's venue, an offer's brand / title or a new shop's name that mean this venue], "records": optional ["event:<id>" | "offer:<id>" | "opening:<id>"] the match misses, "exclude": optional records the match wrongly hits (or that stay as they are), "imageKeys": [GUIDE_IMAGES photo keys of this venue; guide-media.ts marks them subject 'venue'], "approvedAt": "YYYY-MM-DD", and the approval: "ownerQuote" (the owner's own words in chat) for a new approval, or "approvalRecord" (the repo file that records an earlier approval of the same photo as this venue's photo; UI9-IMG-A1a used only such photos, no new image). src/lib/cover-candidates.ts reads it at build time; the 8-year rule still applies to each photo (cover.ts).
